revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_002
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 2, WHITE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "没病走两步" (walk two steps to prove you are fine). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot design as tier 1: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 2 pose: standing upright and trying very hard to walk two neat steps, one tiny arm raised like saying "I'm okay" but with no text, one small comical medical-check style sparkle or pulse-shaped ornament without symbols or letters. Keep it foot-based, silly, charming, not human and not animal.
Medal border: WHITE rank, still pearl-white and silver-white, but slightly more decorated than tier 1: circular raised rim, small white side buckles, two simple pearl studs, subtle silver trim. Do not use green, blue, purple, orange, or gold as rank border colors.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central mascot fully inside circular core. Same base circle size as tier 1.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, playful and polished.
Color palette: pearl white and silver border, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, pale mint/sage micro accents only inside props; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 001-003 white, 004-006 green; future 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
